source.name: measured vapour pressures (an open-access article) and the critical point
source.fit: Fitted to measured vapour pressures (an open-access article): 15 values from 1 articles, none with a stated uncertainty within the 1 % target (1.4-17 %); the fit meets each within its own stated uncertainty (max deviation 15 %), so the record is no better than these values; the ChemSep v8.31 pure-component database, data file 2 normal boiling point (499.00 K); and the ChemSep v8.31 pure-component database, data file 2 critical point (657.86 K, 3566445 Pa). Between 403.16 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the normal boiling point and the critical point. ChemSep stores the vapour pressure in its equation 200, which DWSIM, the open-source program that redistributes the databank, does not define (PropertyPackage.vb, CalcCSTDepProp: no case for it), so it was not used. Articles: Baird et al., Int. J. Thermophys. 40 (2019) 102, doi:10.1007/s10765-019-2570-9. Rules: validation/python/measured_components.py (fit_within_uncertainty).
